commitResults.messageTitle: Match student names ignoring case and spacing
commitResults.messageBody:
Treat names that differ only in letter case or whitespace as the same
student, so that adding 'john tan' when 'John Tan' exists is rejected as
a duplicate. Real-world names are not case-sensitive, and the PE bug
guidelines treat case-sensitive duplicate detection as a feature flaw.

Add Name#isSameName and use it in Student#isSameStudent.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Subject class and subject parsing
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a Subject value class for the s/SUBJECT parameter of 'student add'
(F1), with the validation rules from the Week 6 feature spec: 1 to 30
characters from letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, '+' and '&'.

Add ParserUtil#parseSubject and #parseSubjects. Subjects keep the order
they were given in, and the same subject given twice (ignoring case)
is rejected. Subjects are not yet stored in Student; a later PR will
replace tags with subjects.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add student lookup by name to Model
commitResults.messageBody:
Add Model#findStudentByName, which returns the student whose name
matches the given name ignoring case and extra whitespace.

'student view n/NAME' (F2) will use it, and so can any other command
that takes n/NAME, so that every command looks students up the same
way and shows the same not-found error.

ignoring case and extra spaces.

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace contact fields and tags with subjects
commitResults.messageBody:
TutorLink only needs a student's name and the subjects being tutored
(F1 in the Week 6 feature spec), so remove AB3's phone, email, address
and tag fields.

* Student now has a name and an ordered list of subjects.
* student add takes n/NAME [s/SUBJECT]..., and edit takes n/ and s/
  (s/ on its own clears the subjects).
* Storage saves subjects as a list of strings under 'subjects'.
* The student card shows subjects as chips under the name.
* Sample data, test utilities, tests and test data use subjects.

commitResults.messageTitle: Validate student names using the feature spec rules
commitResults.messageBody:
Follow the F1 rules in the Week 6 feature spec: names are 1 to 50
characters, contain at least one letter, and use only letters
(including accented and non-Latin letters), spaces, hyphens,
apostrophes or full stops. This accepts names such as O'Brien,
Mary-Anne and José, which AB3 rejected, and rejects digits.

Repeated spaces between words are reduced to one when parsing, so
'John   Tan' is stored as 'John Tan' instead of being rejected.

Add 'student view n/NAME' (F2), which shows a student's name and
subjects, or '(none recorded)' if there are none. The name is matched
ignoring case and extra spaces through Model#findStudentByName, and an
unknown name gives "No student named '<name>' found."

The command only reads data; it does not change the student list.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use feature spec messages for student add and view
commitResults.messageBody:
Match the F1 and F2 outputs in the Week 6 feature spec:

* student add shows '✔ Student added: NAME (subjects: ...)' or
  '(no subjects recorded)', followed by the total number of students.
* A duplicate name gives "A student named 'NAME' already exists.
  Student names must be unique."
* Format errors for student add and student view show the command
  format, e.g. 'Command format: student add n/NAME [s/SUBJECT]...'.

Every error shown in the result display now starts with ❌, so all
commands, including later interaction and follow-up commands, follow
the team's message rule without extra code.

commitResults.messageTitle: Show stored name in duplicate error and wrap results
commitResults.messageBody:
When a student is added with a name that differs only in case from an
existing student, the duplicate error now shows the existing student's
name as stored, so the tutor sees which record already exists.

Wrap long messages in the result display instead of showing a
horizontal scroll bar, so error messages can be read in full.

commitResults.messageTitle: Restyle the UI to match the TutorLink mockup
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace AB3's dark single-column layout with the layout and look of
the UI mockup in docs/images/Ui.png, so later features build on the
final structure and style:

* Navy header with the product name; File and Help menus on the right.
* Student index sidebar with initials, subjects and a student count.
* Main area with the result display, a student detail panel, and
  Interactions and Outstanding follow-ups panels side by side.
* Command bar at the bottom.
* New TutorLinkTheme.css replaces DarkTheme.css; colours are listed at
  the top of the file for reuse.

Add a selected student to Model and Logic. student add and student
view select a student, the sidebar highlights it and the panels show
it. The selection follows edits and is cleared on delete or clear.
The Interactions and Follow-ups panels are placeholders for F3 to F6.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep selected and long-named students fully visible
commitResults.messageBody:
Fix two problems found by testing the student index with 46 students
and a 52-character name:

* After student add, the new student at the bottom of the list was
  highlighted but cut off. The list now scrolls by the smallest amount
  that shows the whole selected row, after the new row is laid out.
* A long name widened the list and added a horizontal scroll bar.
  Names and subjects in the student index and detail panel now wrap
  within the available width.

commitResults.messageTitle: Ignore clicks on the student index and explain filters
commitResults.messageBody:
The student index is controlled by commands, but clicking a row
highlighted it without showing that student, which was misleading.
Mouse clicks on the list are now ignored (scrolling still works) and
the list cannot take keyboard focus.

After find, it was unclear how to see all students again. The index
now says 'Showing 2 of 46 · type list to show all' while a filter is
active, and find's result message ends with 'Type list to show all
students again.'

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep selected student consistent with filters
commitResults.messageBody:
After student view, find could hide the selected student from the
student index while the detail panels kept showing them, and any later
find or list removed the highlight even when the student was shown.

* Model#updateFilteredStudentList clears the selected student when the
  new filter hides them, so the panels never show a hidden student.
* The student index restores the highlight whenever the shown list
  changes, and only highlights students that are shown.
